label: Assessing Veterans With Gulf War Illness for Prodromal Parkinson's Disease Risk With the REM Behavioral Sleep Disorder Questionnaire.
summary: To assess deployed Gulf War (GW) veterans for prodromal Parkinson's Disease (PD) using the REM Sleep Behavioral Disorder (RBD) Screening Questionnaire (RBDSQ). GW veterans ( n = 165) were assessed for nonmotor PD symptoms with the RBDSQ, Non-Motor Symptoms Scale, and Scales for Outcomes in Parkinson's Disease-Autonomic. Some veterans were also assessed with the University of Pennsylvania Smell Identification Test ( n = 120), neurological examinations ( n = 41), and 3T magnetic resonance imaging…
